properties.description: Converted (KAN-7): mes.usp_calc_planned_time + rpt.usp_rpt_oee_shift + the Copy to curated are replaced by one Spark job (mfg_lake.jobs.oee_shift). The job builds the shift calendar, imports KAN-6 production and KAN-8 downtime staging, and writes snappy Parquet to abfss://curated@kcmfglake.dfs.core.windows.net/manufacturing/oee_shift — the same location DS_ADLS_Curated_Parquet (report=oee_shift) resolved to; the curated parquet sink is unchanged. Legacy PL_OEE activities have no retry policy; none is added.
